01 · OVERVIEW

StageMate 是什么？｜What is StageMate?

StageMate 是一个专门帮助学生练习英文舞台剧台词的互动式练习工具。它不是单纯的剧本阅读器，而是把 AI 变成你的“对手演员”，陪你一遍一遍练习。

StageMate is an interactive practice tool designed for students learning English drama lines. It is more than a script viewer: the AI acts as your scene partner and helps you rehearse your lines repeatedly.

目前内置 Rapunzel（长发公主），共 4 Acts · 11 Scenes，并为 15 个孩子提供 15 个独立角色。

The current version includes Rapunzel with 4 Acts · 11 Scenes and 15 independent roles for 15 students.

核心概念 · The core idea
听 AI → 等到自己的台词 → 开口说 → 继续下一句。
Listen to the AI → wait for YOUR TURN → speak your line → continue the scene.
02 · HOME

首页｜Home

首页负责三件事：选择剧本、选择 Act / Scene、选择自己的角色。

The Home screen lets you choose the play, Act / Scene, and your own role.

1🔊 Speaker｜声音按钮

点击顶部的声音按钮，可以播放当前台词。它适合用来先听 AI 的发音和语气。

Use the speaker button to play the current line and listen to the AI's pronunciation and delivery.

2Act｜选择幕

选择 Act 1、Act 2、Act 3 或 Act 4。

Choose Act 1, Act 2, Act 3, or Act 4.

3Scene｜选择场景

在当前 Act 中选择具体 Scene。你可以直接从需要练习的位置开始，不必每次从头开始。

Choose a specific Scene within the selected Act. You can start directly from the section you want to practise.

4Role Card｜角色卡

这里选择自己的角色。图中以 Rapunzel 1 为例。点击自己的角色后，StageMate 会把这个角色的台词识别为“你的台词”。

Choose your role here. Rapunzel 1 is shown as the example. Once selected, StageMate treats that role's lines as your lines.

03 · ROLE

角色选择｜Choose Your Role

下面用 Narrator 1 作为滚动位置的示例，说明角色列表和开始按钮。你不需要逐个学习 15 个角色的操作。

Narrator 1 is used as the example in this scroll position. The same process applies to every role.

1选择角色卡｜Select a Role

点击属于你的角色卡。选择后它会成为你的练习身份。

Tap your assigned role card. It becomes your practice identity.

2Start Practicing · 开始练习

选择角色后，点击这个紫色按钮进入 Practice 页面。

After choosing your role, tap this purple button to enter Practice.

04 · PRACTICE

核心功能：对话练习｜Dialogue Practice

Practice 是 StageMate 最核心的页面。你会看到当前场景、自己的角色、台词、中文提示，以及 AI 对手的互动区域。

Practice is the core of StageMate. It shows the current scene, your role, the dialogue, Chinese hints, and the AI scene partner.

1🔊 Speaker｜播放声音

播放当前台词的 AI 语音。

Play the current line using AI voice.

2⚙️ Settings｜练习模式

进入 Practice Mode，选择不同的练习方式。

Open Practice Mode and choose how you want to rehearse.

3← Back｜返回

返回上一层页面。

Return to the previous screen.

4Act｜直接切换幕

在 Practice 页面也可以直接切换 Act，不需要回到首页。

Change the Act directly from Practice without going back Home.

5Scene｜直接切换场景

选择当前 Act 中的另一个 Scene，直接跳到想练习的位置。

Choose another Scene within the current Act and jump directly to it.

6You are · [Role]｜你的角色

确认你现在练习的是哪个角色。

Confirms which role you are practising.

7YOUR TURN｜轮到你

看到这个标记，说明现在轮到你说台词。

When YOUR TURN appears, it is time for you to speak.

8English Line｜英文台词

这里显示当前需要练习的英文台词。

This is the English line you are practising.

9中文提示｜Chinese Hint

英文台词下面有中文翻译，帮助你理解意思。熟悉以后可以尝试不看中文。

A Chinese translation helps you understand the meaning. Once familiar, try practising without looking at it.

10🎙️ Tap to Speak｜点击说话

点击麦克风并说出自己的英文台词。StageMate 会使用语音识别来判断你的回答。

Tap the microphone and speak your English line. StageMate uses speech recognition to process your response.

11▶ Replay AI｜重播 AI

没听清楚时可以重播。也可以用来模仿发音、语速和语气。

Replay the AI line if needed, or use it to imitate pronunciation, pace, and delivery.

12Next →｜下一句

完成当前台词后进入下一句。

Move to the next line after finishing the current one.

Progress Bar · 进度条
紫色进度条位于 Act / Scene 选择框的正下方。随着你完成台词，紫色部分会向右增加，帮助你快速看到当前场景的练习进度。
The purple progress bar sits directly below the Act / Scene selectors. As you move through the lines, the purple section grows to show your progress through the current scene.
05 · PRACTICE MODES

四种练习模式｜Four Practice Modes

点击 Practice 页面右上角的 ⚙️，可以选择适合自己阶段的练习方式。

Tap ⚙️ in Practice to choose the rehearsal mode that matches your current level.

1 · Learning｜学习模式
显示你的台词和中文翻译，适合刚开始熟悉台词。
Shows your lines and Chinese translations. Best for learning and understanding the script.
2 · Practice｜练习模式
减少直接提示，需要自己说出台词，适合记忆练习。
Provides fewer direct prompts and asks you to produce the line yourself.
3 · Rehearsal｜排练模式
尽量不看台词，像真正排练一样与 AI 对戏。
Minimises visible lines so you can rehearse more like a real scene.
4 · Performance｜表演模式
连续完成表演，结束后查看表现评分。
Run through the performance continuously and receive a performance report at the end.
建议顺序 / Suggested progression
Learning → Practice → Rehearsal → Performance
06 · REPORT

Performance Report｜表现报告

完成 Performance 后，可以进入报告页面查看练习结果。

After completing Performance mode, you can view your results in the Performance Report.

Overall Score｜总体评分

查看这次练习的总体表现分数。

Shows the overall score for the practice session.

Lines Remembered｜台词记忆

查看台词记忆表现。

Shows performance related to remembering your lines.

Pronunciation｜发音

查看发音相关表现。

Shows pronunciation-related performance.

Fluency｜流畅度

查看说台词时的流畅度表现。

Shows fluency-related performance.

Try Again｜再次练习

完成一次练习后，可以重新开始练习。

Start another practice session after reviewing your result.

07 · FULL FLOW

一次完整练习｜Full Practice Flow

1Choose an Act｜选择 Act
Choose the Act you want to practise.
2Choose a Scene｜选择 Scene
Choose the specific scene.
3Choose Your Role｜选择自己的角色
Select your assigned role.
4Start Practicing｜开始练习
Enter the Practice screen.
5Listen｜听 AI
Listen to the AI scene partner.
6YOUR TURN｜轮到你
Speak your own line.
7Replay AI｜重播
Replay whenever you need another listen.
8Next｜下一句
Continue the scene.
9Performance｜表演
Try a full run-through when ready.
10Report｜报告
Review your practice result.
最简单的记法 / The simple rule
Listen → Speak → Replay → Next
听 → 说 → 重播 → 下一句
